record.short: Canva Business billing moved from paying only for members who accept an invite to buying a paid seat for every member.
record.headline: Canva’s Business FAQ now says every team member needs a paid seat, bought when you send the invite, instead of billing only for members who accept.
rows: Pay only for members who accept the invitation

record.who: Canva Business teams adding or removing members; the page does not say whether existing teams are affected.
record.read: Teams that invite people who never join, or that remove members, may now pay for idle seats. This reads as a tightening of seat billing, but it is inferred from FAQ text alone.
record.caveat: The page returned two versions in this run; one omits the FAQ entry entirely, so this may be a rollout or rendering difference. No list prices changed.
